programme.desc: S2:E4 Pingu et l'aimant | Pingu reçoit de l'aide | Pingu au paradis - Pingu découvre un aimant et décide de l'utiliser pour piéger son ami. | Pingu joue avec son bateau, mais il coule à cause d'une fuite. | Après s'être endormi en jouant avec ses jouets, Pingu fait un rêve très doux.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E5 La blague dangereuse de Pingu | Pingu le pilote | Pingu taquine Pinga
programme.desc: S2:E5 La blague dangereuse de Pingu | Pingu le pilote | Pingu taquine Pinga - Pingu fait une blague dangereuse à son grand-père. | Pingu et Pinga construisent leur avion après en avoir vu un vrai. | Pingu taquine tellement sa sœur avec ses blagues qu'elle est presque en pleurs.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E6 Le vœu de Pingu | Pingu est curieux | Pingu s'organise
programme.desc: S2:E6 Le vœu de Pingu | Pingu est curieux | Pingu s'organise - Pingu voit un kit de magie dans le magasin et le veut vraiment. | Pingu découvre un gros cadeau pour son anniversaire. Il veut l'ouvrir mais on lui dit d'attendre. | Quand papa insiste pour que Pingu range tout à sa place, Pingu s'organise.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E7 Pingu construit une tour | Pingu le roi | Pingu le boulanger
programme.desc: S2:E7 Pingu construit une tour | Pingu le roi | Pingu le boulanger - Pingu voit dans un livre une tour qui monte jusqu'au ciel et veut en construire une identique. | Pinga découvre un livre sur les royaumes et Pingu pense que ce serait génial d'être roi. | Pingu veut faire son propre gâteau.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E8 Pingu et la poupée | Pingu aide grand-père | La mauvaise journée de Pingu
programme.desc: S2:E8 Pingu et la poupée | Pingu aide grand-père | La mauvaise journée de Pingu - Le bras de l'ours de Pinga se détache quand Pingu joue avec. | Pingu part à pied aider grand-père à cause des retards de la motoneige. | Pingu trébuche sur ses jouets, fait un mauvais trajet jusqu'à l'école et ne sait pas répondre au maître.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E9 Pingu perd le pari | Pingu et sa coupe | La carte de Saint-Valentin de Pingi
programme.desc: S2:E9 Pingu perd le pari | Pingu et sa coupe | La carte de Saint-Valentin de Pingi - Pour se montrer, Pingu parie avec Pinga qu'il est meilleur qu'elle pour viser une boîte avec des balles. | Pingu est très mauvais lors de sa journée sportive. En aidant un ami lors de la dernière épreuve, Pingu gagne le premier prix. | Pingu est ravi de recevoir une carte de Saint-Valentin de Pingi.

programme.title: Jadore Jack
programme.desc: Carly craque sur un garçon à l'école nommé Jake. Il est cool et sexy. Puisqu'elle l'aime bien, elle l'invite à auditionner sur son site. Malheureusement, elle comprend un peu tard que Jake est le pire chanteur du monde !

programme.title: Recherche Téléspectateurs
programme.desc: Carly et Sam se battent contre Freddie et Spencer pour décider de qui aura le meilleur plan pour rameuter les foules sur iCarly. La situation dégénère quand tous leur plans tournent à la catastrophe.

programme.title: Nevelocity
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie veulent qu'une critique de leur émission soit faite sur "Nevelocity", un site très populaire qui poste des critiques sur d'autres sites et émissions en ligne.

programme.title: Carly veut rester avec Spencer
programme.desc: Le grand-père de Carly et Spencer leur fait une visite surprise. Il est préoccupé par le fait que Spencer soit trop irresponsable et fainéant pour être le tuteur de Carly.

programme.title: Espionnage
programme.desc: Carly décide de faire une émission montrant ce que font les méchants profs quand ils ne sont pas à l'école. Elle décide de suivre son prof principal, Miss Briggs, mais se retrouve piégée avec Freddie dans l'appartement de Miss Briggs.

programme.title: Champion du monde
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie essayent de battre le record du monde de l'émission du web la plus longue. Pour ce faire, iCarly doit durer plus de 24h d'affilée...

programme.title: Freddie a une copine
programme.desc: Une fan d'iCarly, Valerie, demande à Freddie de sortir avec elle. Leur relation se passe si bien que Freddie commence à filmer la propre émission de Valerie.

programme.title: Naissance dun artiste
programme.desc: Carly invite l'idole de Spencer, Harry Joyner, pour qu'il puisse admirer son œuvre. Quand Harry qualifie son travail d'amateur, Spencer a le sentiment que sa vie n'avait plus de but.

programme.title: La plus grande des fans
programme.desc: La plus grande fan d'iCarly, Mandy, est invitée sur le plateau de l'émission comme seul public. Mandy s'avèrera être plus une traqueuse qu'une fan, et les enfants vont vite vouloir s'en débarrasser...

programme.title: Poussins.com
programme.desc: Carly et Sam cherchent à féconder des poules pour leur projet de sciences. Mais les poules s'échappent de l'incubateur...

programme.title: Je ne veux pas dembrouilles
programme.desc: Carly fabrique pour Sam un unique T-shirt iCarly pour commémorer l'anniversaire de leur amitié. Mais quand Sam échange le t-shirt contre des billets de concert, les deux amies se disputent.

programme.title: On peut toujours rêver
programme.desc: iCarly demande à ses fans d'envoyer des vidéos d'eux-mêmes pratiquant leur plus belle danse. Carly, Sam et Freddie recoivent plus de 3000 vidéos et se retrouvent à veiller toute la nuit pour les regarder.

programme.title: Joyeux Halloween
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie tournent iCarly dans un appartement prétendument hanté. Quand des choses étranges se mettent à se passer, les amis se demandent si les rumeurs de fantômes ne sont pas fondées...

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Spencer sauve la vie du chanteur de The Plain White T's et le convainc de participer à iCarly. Mais des choses étranges se mettent à arriver sur le plateau et l'on se rend vite compte que c'est Nevel qui essaye de saboter iCarly...

programme.title: Jai été collée
programme.desc: Sam est punie la nuit de la cinquantième émission d'iCarly. Inapte à faire l'enregistrement, Carly et Freddie font leur possible pour être punis à leur tour afin de diffuser l'émission durant la nuit, avec Sam.

programme.title: La Nuit des chauves-souris 2
programme.desc: L'histoire suit un groupe de soldats en mission dans une zone isolée pour capturer un scientifique fou, qui se retrouve la proie de chauves-souris carnivores génétiquement modifiées.

programme.title: Abraham Lincoln Contre Les Zombies
programme.desc: Durant la guerre civile, Abraham Lincoln apprend qu'une menace pèse sur l'avenir des États-Unis. Une armée de morts-vivants sudistes erre sur la surface du continent. En passant derrière les lignes ennemies, le Président se donne pour mission de détruire les zombies...

programme.title: Pulse 2: Afterlife
programme.desc: Après que des fantômes ont envahi le monde des humains par le biais d'Internet, un père doit protéger sa fille de l'esprit psychotique de son ex-femme.

programme.title: Mémoires diaboliques
programme.desc: Lea, une femme napolitaine d'âge mûr vivant dans une ville du nord du pays, a eu treize enfants, tous morts à l'exception de Michele pour qui elle a une affection morbide, convaincue qu'elle l'a volé à la mort.

programme.title: Double Destinée
programme.desc: Eve, une organisatrice de fêtes qui doit choisir entre un événement de dernière minute et des vacances romantiques. Tandis qu'elle réfléchit à ces deux perspectives, laquelle choisira-t-elle?

programme.title: Christmas do over
programme.desc: Se sentant obligé de passer Noël chez son ex-femme, son jeune fils et ses anciens beaux-parents, un auteur de jingles sans grande envergure se retrouve à vivre le jour de Noël encore et encore. Avant de pouvoir reprendre le cours de sa vie, il devra déterminer ce qui doit changer dans sa vie.

programme.title: Deux Cupidons Pour Noël
programme.desc: Holly enseigne la littérature et cherche le grand amour. Elle rencontre Josh, un bel avocat, qui peine à la séduire. Josh engage son ami David, lui aussi professeur de littérature, pour écrire des poèmes à Holly à sa place.

programme.title: Noël dans la prairie
programme.desc: Le seul souhait de Kendall pour les fêtes est de maintenir le ranch familial à flot. Le charmant fils de son rival lui propose son aide – et peut-être plus – mais peut-on lui faire confiance ?

programme.title: Willy's Wonderland
programme.desc: Un mystérieux vagabond se fait piéger et accepte un travail de concierge dans un parc d'attractions condamné appelé Willy's Wonderland. Il découvre bien vite qu'il est en fait un sacrifice humain pour d'étranges créatures. Le parc se transforme en effet en cauchemar vivant peuplé d'animatroniques possédés par des démons...

programme.title: Italian Race
programme.desc: Giulia est une championne de course en puissance qui voit sa vie basculer lorsque son père décède. Mineure, elle ne peut compter que sur son frère qu'elle n'a pas vu depuis dix ans et qui est toxicomane. Ensemble, ils vont essayer de remonter la pente grâce à leur passion commune : la course automobile.

programme.title: Madtown
programme.desc: Un homme, terrifié par sa soeur, doit se confronter à cette dernière des années plus tard, lorsqu'elle est libérée de prison.

programme.title: Bad Man
programme.desc: Bobby Gaines, un agent infiltré charismatique et détonnant, débarque dans la ville de Colt Lake pour enquêter sur un trafic de méthamphétamine. Mais derrière son image de héros, de sombres secrets menacent de tout faire exploser.

programme.title: Nice
programme.desc: Martial, 17 ans, a fugué à Nice pour venir voir sa mère, chanteuse à la vie chaotique. Près de la maison de celle-ci, il rencontre trois femmes : une employée des Assédic, une ancienne camarade de classe et la propriétaire des lieux. Trois fragments d'éducation sentimentale, trois secrets, trois chansons.

programme.title: Tapette
programme.desc: Alors qu'il est sur le point de s'installer avec sa petite amie, Michel a une montée d'angoisse. Pour éviter de s'engager, il va se persuader qu'il est homosexuel.

programme.title: Journée d'appel
programme.desc: Une bande de jeunes banlieusards passe leur journée d'appel à la caserne de Versailles. L'un d'eux, Chris, arrivé trop tard à la caserne, veut rentrer au quartier, mais Momo, une baltringue de leur cité, le persuade de passer la journée au château de Versailles.

programme.title: Obras
programme.desc: Obras propose, en un unique plan-séquence, un voyage dans le temps et l'espace, une déambulation poétique, graphique et sonore qui traduit visuellement les mutations urbaines, sauvages et irréversibles, à travers la destruction / reconstruction de Barcelone.

programme.title: Ghost Cell
programme.desc: À la fois film scientifique, documentaire et balade onirique, Ghost Cell est une plongée en relief au coeur des entrailles d'un Paris organique vu comme une cellule au travers d'un microscope virtuel.

programme.title: Eclipse
programme.desc: Sur une planète éloignée, deux scientifiques venus analyser le terrain pour ses particularités magnétiques sont confrontés à un phénomène extraordinaire lié à une éclipse de lune.

programme.title: Grounded
programme.desc: Un jeune soldat sans expérience est envoyé à un poste de surveillance, au beau milieu d'un désert.

programme.title: Aquabike
programme.desc: Traumatisée par un poisson, Sophie n'a jamais remis les pieds dans l'eau depuis ses 15 ans. Aujourd'hui elle en a 35 et sa copine Anaïs a décidé de l'emmener voir Aquaman, un gourou-guérisseur aux méthodes radicales.

programme.title: Oripeaux
programme.desc: Dans un village isolé, une petite fille se lie d'amitié avec une meute de coyotes. Les villageois mettent brutalement fin à cette relation sans se douter du soulèvement qui les guette

programme.title: Les aoutiens
programme.desc: André est mis à la porte par sa copine un matin d'août avec pour seul bagage son immense plant de cannabis. Impossible de traverser seul Paris avec ce fardeau illégal et encombrant. André demande donc l'aide de Joël, un ami d'enfance frivole.

programme.title: La bête
programme.desc: Une jeune femme se caresse. De ses poils naît une bête démesurée, dont le corps épouse et violente le sien.

programme.title: Zoo
programme.desc: Des menstruations de leurs filles à la naissance de leur chien, tout est sous contrôle dans la vie d'Emmanuelle et Olivier Teziev. Mais ce matin Léa, leur fille cadette, n'est pas descendue déjeuner. Sur son lit, à sa place, les Teziev et Emilie, leur aînée, découvrent avec horreur un monstrueux cocon. Progressivement le chaos s'installe.

programme.title: Argile
programme.desc: Alex pose. Une vieille dame sculpte. Une situation normale... si la dame en question n'était pas une aveugle et n'avait pour « voir » que ses mains. Des mains ridées qu'elle pose sur le corps nu de son jeune modèle. Alex va connaître une séance de pose inhabituelle.

programme.title: Fard
programme.desc: Dans un futur proche, le monde semble fonctionner de façon efficace et contrôlée...

programme.title: A/K
programme.desc: A/K c'est l'histoire de Kim et Anouk qui attendent un bus qui n'arrivera jamais. Pour passer le temps, elles inventent une histoire, celle de Ted « le flic cowboy » et de « Joe le solitaire ». Alors que leurs aventures s'enchaînent au rythme de la folle imagination des deux filles, la voiture de police de Ted s'arrête devant leur abris bus.

programme.title: La peur du vide
programme.desc: Simone est une vieille dame isolée, dont le quotidien est rythmé par un étrange tas de détritus, si imposant dans son petit appartement qu'il l'empêche de vivre normalement. Un jour, Simone se risque à y toucher...

programme.title: Chienne d'histoire
programme.desc: Constantinople 1910. Trop de chiens errants dans les rues de la ville. Le gouvernement en place cherche le moyen de s'en débarrasser avant de décider de déporter 30 000 chiens sur une île déserte au large de la ville.

programme.title: Faites l'amour !
programme.desc: Vincent et Margot, deux acteurs, doivent tourner une scène d'amour. Mais la frontière entre le jeu et la réalité est mince, au moins autant que celle entre l'amour et la haine. À eux d'en faire l'expérience.

programme.title: Denis et les zombies
programme.desc: Mathias emmène ses camarades tourner un film de zombies dans la maison de campagne familiale. Mais les autochtones ne voient pas le tournage d'un très bon œil et Denis, l'ami d'enfance de Mathias, va se révéler de plus en plus collant.

programme.title: Bootyful
programme.desc: Estelle ne s'attendait pas à rencontrer Sacha ce samedi soir. Travesti et libéré, ce dernier va faire voler en éclats ses idées très arrêtées sur la danse, la séduction, l'amour...

programme.title: L'échappée
programme.desc: Alice chante, se maquille et rigole toute seule. Elle est heureuse. Pourtant elle est à l'hôpital, et vient de se faire opérer. Elle est très malade et totalement chauve. Mais elle est amoureuse de son chirurgien. Il l'a sauvée et vient la voir tous les soirs dans sa chambre. Ses visites sont pour Alice un moment magique qui lui permettent d'oublier son insupportable situation. Alice s'échappe dans son imaginaire et se réinvente une vie plus douce et pleine d'amour…

programme.title: Johnno's Dead
programme.desc: Passer 12 ans derrière les barreaux pour un crime que vous n'avez pas commis, ça fait cogiter. Tout devient clair comme l'eau de roche. L'injustice empoisonne l'esprit, et il ne reste plus que de vieux comptes à régler.

programme.title: Brexicuted
programme.desc: Ce film d'animation satirique dépeint les causes du Brexit. Un groupe de personnages anglais, interrogés au lendemain du vote pour la sortie du Royaume-Uni de l'Union européenne, parlent de ce qui a motivé leur décision.

programme.title: Tokyo Tribe
programme.desc: Dans un Tokyo futuriste, la ville est divisée en quartiers, dirigés par des gangs distincts. Mera, le chef de l'un d'eux, souhaite régler une affaire personnelle avec un membre d'une faction rivale, entraînant ainsi une guerre totale.

programme.title: Night Hunter
programme.desc: Jack Cutter est le dernier d'une longue lignée de chasseurs de vampires. Après avoir tué quelques vampires dans un restaurant de Los Angeles, il est poursuivi à la fois par la police et par d'autres vampires. Au cours de cette aventure, il rencontre une journaliste séduisante.

programme.title: SuperGrid
programme.desc: Dans un avenir où une peste a infecté une grande partie de la population deux frères sont chargés de se rendre au Canada pour récupérer un mystérieux colis.

programme.title: L'aquarium de la mort
programme.desc: Un accident scientifique transforme les créatures marines d'un aquarium en zombies.

programme.title: Point De Chute
programme.desc: Trois voyous enlèvent une jeune fille de quinze ans, Patricia, pour obtenir de son père le versement d'une rançon. Ils la séquestrent dans une cabane perdue au bord de la mer et la battent. Seul Eddie, un jeune voyou, gardien de la jeune fille, s'insurge contre ces méthodes. A travers un fait divers tragique, le portrait de deux adolescents dans un climat d'angoisse et de violence.

programme.title: Dangerous Intentions
programme.desc: Depuis des années, Beth Williamson supporte le comportement extrêmement violent de son mari Tim. Elle cache la terrible réalité à sa famille ainsi qu'à ses amis, mais surtout à sa fille Laurie. Un jour, elle décide de prendre sa vie en main et retourne chez sa mère. Emprisonné puis relâché, Tim a juré de se venger. Entre temps Beth rencontre Kaye, elle aussi victime de violence conjugale. Les deux amies prennent une maison ensemble en espérant que la vie va enfin commencer pour elles et leurs enfants...

programme.title: Gandahar
programme.desc: Gandahar, paisible oasis au cour d'une galaxie agitée, est menacée par une force terrible et mystérieuse.

programme.title: Bangkok Fighter
programme.desc: Manit, un petit garçon de dix ans assiste à l'assassinat de ses parents. Implacables, les tueurs décident de l'éliminer. Touché à la tête, l'enfant survit miraculeusement à ses blessures, mais se retrouve frappé d'ataraxie. Les dommages provoqués à son cerveau lui ont enlevé toute émotion. Sauvé d'une mort certaine par un vieux maître d'arts martiaux, Manit, 20 ans plus tard, devenu une véritable machine de guerre, retourne sur les lieux de son enfance. La justice va s'abattre... Et des hommes vont mourir

programme.title: Bruce Lee: Immortal Dragon
programme.desc: Un regard sur la vie de la superstar Bruce Lee.

programme.title: In The Blink Of An Eye
programme.desc: Micki Dickoff abandonne sa carrière pour aider un ami emprisonné pour meurtre.

programme.title: The Interview
programme.desc: Dave et son équipe ils découvrent que le dirigeant nord-coréen Kim Jong-un est un fan de leur show...

programme.title: Altamira
programme.desc: 1878, près de Santander. Marcelino Sanz, un paléontologue amateur, découvre dans une grotte des peintures rupestres. Mais sa découverte agite le clergé Monseigneur tente de manipuler sa femme, Conchita, et sa fille, en tentant de les éloigner de l'influence rationaliste de Marcelino.

programme.title: Le cri du faucon
programme.desc: Une petite frappe en cavale va devenir le coach de catch et allié de Zak, un jeune homme trisomique. Zak est lui aussi en fuite, il a quitté son foyer en vue d'essayer de réaliser son rêve : celui de devenir une catcheur professionnel et rejoindre l'école de catch de Saltwater Redneck.

programme.title: Ophelia
programme.desc: L'esprit singulier d'Ophélie capture l'affection de Hamlet. Pendant que la luxure et la trahison menacent le royaume, Ophélie se retrouve coincée entre le véritable amour et le contrôle de son propre destin.

programme.title: Grey Lady
programme.desc: Après le meurtre de sa partenaire policière et amante à Boston, le détective James Doyle, détective criminel, suit un indice dans ses derniers mots qui le mène sur l'île isolée de Nantucket, à la recherche de son assassin, pendant la morte-saison.

programme.title: Le Pacte des copines
programme.desc: Abandonnée devant l'autel, Ella part en lune de miel avec son amie Lindsey, qui cache son amour pour un homme.

programme.title: Coup de foudre au manoir
programme.desc: Isabella et Blake organisent une fête au manoir, ignorant les surprises qui les attendent.

programme.title: Dans l'enfer de la captivité
programme.desc: Mai 1977, Janice et Cameron prennent une auto-stoppeuse nommée Colleen dans leur voiture et la kidnappent,

programme.title: Les messagers
programme.desc: Une famille quitte la ville animée de Chicago en faveur d'une nouvelle vie dans une ferme de tournesols isolée. Mais leur nouveau départ vire rapidement au cauchemar lorsqu'une série d'étranges événements les poussent à croire qu'ils ne sont pas seuls dans leur nouvelle maison.

programme.title: Boogeyman
programme.desc: Un homme essaie de se débarrasser de visions horribles et commence à soupçonner que ce qu'il voit sont de sombres souvenirs d'enfance.

programme.title: Mandrake
programme.desc: La quête d'une dague fabuleuse réveille un monstre. Mi-plante, mi-animale, la créature se réveille et a soif de sang humain.

programme.title: Cabin Fever
programme.desc: Piégé dans un chalet isolé dans la montagne, un groupe d'étudiants fraîchement diplômés est progressivement décimé par un effroyable virus mangeur de chair.

programme.title: Dérive mortelle
programme.desc: Un week-end de croisière sur un luxueux yacht tourne mal pour un groupe d'anciens amis de lycée.

programme.title: Beyond the Edge
programme.desc: Une bande d'arnaqueurs talentueux dotés de superpouvoirs tente de dévaliser un énorme casino, mais c'est sans compter sur un mystérieux rival qui semble tous les surpasser…

programme.title: Harlem Nights
programme.desc: On retrouve ici trois générations de légendes de la comédie. Le patron de boîte de nuit Sugar Ray (Richard Pryor) et son fils Quick (Eddie Murphy) se battent pour empêcher un dangereux gangster et une police corrompue de faire couler leur boîte.

programme.title: Sex Therapy
programme.desc: Trois accros du sexe suivent un programme en 12 étapes, à New York, pour s'en sortir.

programme.title: Welcome Back
programme.desc: Un militaire de renom retourne sur les terres ou il a connu les plus grands succes de sa carriere. Alors qu'il renoue des liens avec un amour de jeunesse, il tombe contre toute attente sous le charme d'une militaire de l'Air Force qu'on lui a assigné.

programme.desc: Retrouvez toutes les bandes annonces de vos films et séries préférés.

Steve Harvey remarquent que ces femmes sont capables de diriger une petite entreprise, de s'occuper à merveille d'une famille de trois jeunes enfants et ou encore de diriger un groupe communautaire en même temps, mais sont incapables de découvrir ce qui plaît aux hommes. Pour lui, elles ne doivent par chercher conseil auprès d'autres femmes : seul un homme peut leur dire comment séduire un homme et le garder. programme.title: Lucas Jones Explores What We're All Searching For In Life
programme.desc: Poet and actor Lucas Jones joins Fearne Cotton to explore what we're all searching for in life—whether we call it God, the Universe, spirituality, or science. They bond over their inability to do small talk, preferring deeper conversations about big feelings, and both share their experiences of living with OCD. Lucas discusses how therapy, particularly CBT, has helped him, but questions whether the rise in therapy reflects a loss of real community.

programme.title: Bryony Gordon On How People Pleasing Fuelled My OCD
programme.desc: Author and mental health advocate Bryony Gordon explores how people pleasing has fuelled parts of her OCD, alcoholism, and eating disorders over the years. Fearne and Bryony discuss the 'fawn' trauma response - appeasing others to stay safe - and chat about body image and the insecurities that have consumed them. Bryony reckons feeling 'too much' and 'not enough' are two sides of the same coin, and offers advice on how to confidently take up space.

programme.title: Boy George on AI, Spirituality & Why Jealousy Is Pointless
programme.desc: Boy George joins Fearne to discuss ego, jealousy, fame, grief and the mindset shift that changed everything. From embracing the Three Principles to tapping every morning, he explains how learning to pause before reacting helped him let go of resentment and feel lighter than ever. He opens up about loving fame and why he'd do it differently if he could start again, AI, and why "hating someone is completely pointless".

programme.title: Philippa Perry On Why Everyone Has an Inner Critic
programme.desc: Psychotherapist and author Philippa Perry discusses why everyone has an inner critic and how to stop believing yours. Philippa explains why not feeling 'good enough' is often less about truth and more about habit. She shares how to tell the difference between a helpful critical inner voice and a self-sabotaging one, and why negative thought patterns keep us stuck.

programme.title: Sam Thompson On His Anxiety And Undiagnosed ADHD
programme.desc: Sam Thompson discusses how anxiety and undiagnosed ADHD have shaped his relationships and self-confidence. He shares his experience of panic attacks, including one on the first day of I'm A Celebrity, and talks about therapy, the patterns he kept repeating, and his three go-to people during crises. Sam and Fearne debate people-pleaser approaches to leaving parties and discuss behind-the-scenes stories from his content creation work. Sam also reveals why he was willing to pay to appear on I'm A Celebrity.

programme.title: Sam Claflin Asks What Is Body Dysmorphia?
programme.desc: Actor Sam Claflin discusses his lifelong struggle with body dysmorphia and body image with Fearne Cotton. Sam explains what having body dysmorphia means to him and how it affects everything from the food he eats to his willingness to watch his own films back. Fearne and Sam discuss being chronic people pleasers and how they're working to stop putting everyone else's comfort before their own. Sam reflects on how he was brought up to think about masculinity and what he's doing to ensure his own son grows up with gentler male role models. They also reminisce about the early days of MSN and webcam chatrooms.

programme.title: Chris Appleton: From Being Bullied to Styling the Kardashians
programme.desc: Celebrity hair stylist Chris Appleton chats with Fearne about why we change our hair when we want to start over. Chris explains that everyone from the Kardashians to cancer patients have opened up to him about their insecurities, and he's seen the profound impact that looking more like yourself on the outside can have on how you feel about yourself on the inside. He's fascinated by the self-limiting beliefs people have about who they are. Chris has dealt with a lot of his own shame and fears too. He was bullied at school, struggled to acknowledge his sexuality, and had huge imposter syndrome when he first arrived in Hollywood. He also gives Fearne a consultation about going bolder with her hair. Content warning: this episode contains frank conversation about suicidal ideation.

programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: My Troublesome Star Ep.6
programme.desc: Actress Im Se Ra (Jang Da A) is on top of the world after becoming the youngest winner of a best actress award. Unfortunately, that same night, she's hit by a truck - and transported 25 years into the future, where she wakes up in the body of middle-aged woman Bong Cheong Ja (Uhm Jung Hwa). Cheong Ja decides to return to acting, hoping to restore her former glory and figure out what happened to her. She's assisted by Dokgo Cheol (Song Seung Heon), a former violent crimes detective who got demoted to traffic duty... and who shares a mysterious past connection with Se Ra. To both Cheong Ja and Cheol's surprise, they begin to fall for each other, sending their lives onto an entirely new trajectory.

While surveying the village, he unexpectedly encounters Jeongi, who is making and distributing bowls to the villagers. Jeongi carefully presents a vessel she crafted especially for Gwanghae. Soon, a royal decree is issued for the Bunwon to produce pottery for the common people, and Gwanghae sets out to find Jeongi.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.21

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.22

programme.title: Tropical (Kingdom's of the Sun)
programme.desc: The tropics can be found in the band around the centre of the Earth. This position shapes dramatic landscapes and a range of challenges to all who live there. Tropics are perhaps best known for rainforests thanks to the extensive rains and lush, fruiting vegetation, these exhibit the greatest biodiversity of any habitat on the planet. The tropics aren't just about rainforests, however. They also support remarkable grasslands and even deserts, where yet more incredible flora and fauna can be found.

programme.title: The Return of the Osprey
programme.desc: The Osprey is the only raptor in the world to feed exclusively on fish. This migratory bird has lived throughout central Europe for a long time, nesting there in the summer months. But the species has gradually moved to more northerly regions of the continent, far from the persecution caused by human expansion. Wendy and Denis have set launched an ambitious challenge of reintroducing the Osprey to Switzerland, a century after its disappearance.

programme.title: Hidden Japan
programme.desc: Japan is the fourth largest island nation in the world and the second most populous. The culture of Japan is incredible, but even this is overshadowed by nature's beauty. There are more than 130 mammals and an astonishing 600 bird species dwelling in Japan's 6,852 islands. This island chain is so long that it spans several climate zones, providing a huge range of habitat for wildlife. Look beyond the ancient temples and glass skyscrapers and volcanos loom, bears hunt and birds do battle. This is the hidden Japan.

programme.title: Hidden Spain
programme.desc: Spain is found at the crossroads between the Mediterranean and the Atlantic, resulting in diverse landscapes, ancient cultures and magnificent wildlife.

programme.title: Hidden UK
programme.desc: For its tiny size the UK is a hugely varied landscape with a surprising collection of natural history – from the English Channel and famous white cliffs, to ancient forests and dramatic mountains. Indisputably stunning landscapes, providing homes for noble stags, soaring eagles, playful dolphins and endlessly entertaining otters. And this is just the tip of the iceberg – countless discoveries are waiting to be unearthed if you decide step off the beaten track in search of the hidden UK.

programme.title: Pythons and the Exotic Pet Trade
programme.desc: For those of us that long to escape the rat race the pull of the wild can be strong. Whether we're risking our lives with extreme sports, following our animal passions or just taking a walk on the wild side, the natural world calls to us. What's more, the power of nature tests our limits, opens our eyes and heals our hearts in equal measure. So why try to resist such a beautiful, exciting and enlightening siren song? Perhaps there's nothing better for us humans than to follow the pull of the wild.

programme.title: Monkey Mayhem
programme.desc: Monkeys: loveable, aggressive, diverse and full of mischief. Our distant cousins have much in common with us. They're intelligent, cooperative and have complex relationships. They're some of the most evolutionary successful species on the planet, successful across the globe from Japanese snow monkeys to African baboons. Swinging through our family tree quickly reveals the diversity of our monkey relatives. They come in all shapes and sizes, and are certainly not as different from us as we might think.

programme.title: Tropical (Kingdom's of the Sun)
programme.desc: The tropics can be found in the band around the centre of the Earth. This position shapes dramatic landscapes and a range of challenges to all who live there. programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: Dramatically, the coast plunges into the sea, the so-called Costa of Peru is a gigantic desert on the Pacific Ocean, 2,400 kilometers long. Rugged, bizarre, like from another star. Ancient cultures settled here, the Moche and the Chimú. Later the proud Inca, the self-proclaimed royal people of the Andes, ruled. In the small town of Huanchaco in northern Peru, the fishermen build a new boat every month: from reed. The small ships are called Caballito de Totora (reed horses), because the shape is reminiscent of a horse and the fishermen ride in it kneeling in the waves. About 2,000 years ago, the moche used it to go out to sea. Carlos Segura Azola is a descendant of the moche. He is currently building a "reed horse" again. But actually something completely different occupies him. Carlos has been afraid of the sea ever since his father drowned at work. The fisherman consults a Brucha, a witch. She tries to drive him out of panic at the Pacific with mysterious ceremonies. At some point Carlos' reed boat is finished and he has to get out to his nets again. In the south, in the port city of Pisco, there are hardly any private cars. Mototaxis on three wheels are the means of transport here. Every moto looks different, because the young drivers compete with each other. They constantly pimp out their tricycles with spoilers, mirrors and all kinds of decorations. Because if you stand out in the traffic jam, you get the most passengers. But nowhere else in Peru is road traffic as dense and chaotic as in the capital Lima. That's why Juan Ortiz goes daily with his Delta glider over the coastal road into the air. He is the flying reporter and reports live for the traffic news. And he is not alone with his aircraft. Dozens of paragliders float along the cliffs of Lima at any time of the day. The Pacific provides a constant upwind on the up to 160 meter high cliffs. Somewhere in the labyrinth of the metropolis of millions hundreds of believers trot to the beat of the music of a Jesus statue on the cross. A procession for the "Lord of Miracles", the brass band intones church songs. The music student Bruno Alvarado drags and plays the largest instrument, a sousaphone. Every day there are dozens of processions in Lima. Practical for Bruno, he finances his studies with the musical accompaniment. Away from the hustle and bustle of the big city, in the Paracas National Park, it is deserted. Luis Zapato runs a kiosk on a lonely beach amidst huge sand dunes. The kiosk has meanwhile developed into a gourmet temple, even the capital city dwellers flock here. Especially because of the scallops that Luis is the only licence holder to collect far and wide from the seabed. Inti Mar he called his beach snack, Inti is the sun god, Mar the sea. At Luis you literally eat like a sun god at the sea. This is only possible here, on the Inca coast.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: The palm tree laden beaches on Mexico's Riviera Maya on the Yucatan peninsula are endless, and the turquoise sea with its gentle Caribbean surf is a warm 25 degrees during the mild winter in this part of the world. Between Cancún and Punta Allen, where once there was little more than bushland and a few sleepy fishing villages, vibrant life has evolved during the past three decades. Richard Sowa has lived on a floating island for the past 15 years: an island he built himself out of empty plastic bottles. The bon vivant him-self sees it as a "solution for our planet's refuse problem". Off Punta Allen, a village in the bay of Sian Ka'an, Mexican Mara Coral Ley and her cousin Kim, continue to catch lobsters by adhering to the traditional method and were awarded an "Eco seal for sustainable fishing" for their trouble. It is silent under water off Isla Mujeres and it is here that the artist Jason deCaires has constructed a sculpture park. Hundreds of lifesize figures form an artificial reef at a depth of 12 metres. Fish and plants complete his work of art. The master himself is convinced: "Mother Nature is the true artist".

programme.title: glCuba
programme.desc: Even anyone who has not yet been to Cuba can conjure up certain images of American vintage street cruisers, imposing buildings that have seen better days, white sandy beaches full of palms and loving couples on the Malecón against a backdrop of crashing waves. This island is somewhat of a myth and its people generate a special joie de vivre. The legendary Hershey Train departs for Matanzas from the capital, Havana. On the oldest electrified railway line in the Caribbean, 60-year-old Spanish carriages make their way along al-most 100 kilometres of coastline in the most relaxed way possible. The Salvavidas on Varadero, probably the most famous beach on the island, have a particular-ly beautiful workplace. The lifeguards' territory ex-tends for more than 20 kilometres. In order to protect the coasts of Cuba, mangroves have been replanted here for many years. The project is supported by the UN and planting is often carried out by schoolchildren. In doing so, Cuban children learn how to treat their maritime habitat in a sustainable fashion. The former colonial city of Trinidad on Cuba's south coast is gen-erally considered to be one of the most beautiful places in the entire Caribbean. The houses here are particular-ly colourful. A plethora of magnificent buildings can be seen at the Plaza Mayor, the neo-baroque main square.

programme.title: Enkrypted
programme.desc: Falsely imprisoned, the Ninja are at their lowest point, but find an unlikely friend in an old enemy. Meanwhile, Nadakhan rescues his marooned crew and gains a new perspective, along with a new mysterious plan. With the ninja imprisoned, Nadakhan uses the Realm Crystal to free his old crew. The ninja encounter Captain Soto, the first captain of the Destiny's Bounty, who tells them the story of how he originally trapped Nadakhan in the Teapot. Nadakhan vows revenge on the ninja and NINJAGO. The ninja and Soto escape from jail, only to find out the map to the island is on Nadakhan's ship. Nadakhan discovers that Nya looks just like Delara, his long-lost love.The secret, he says, is the venom of a Tiger Widow, a rare creature that lives on only one island. The venom can slow a djinn down. Soto is the only one who knows where the island is and will only tell if the ninja break him out of jail. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has decided to return to his home realm of Djinjago, only to discover it is falling apart. The ninja's destruction of the Cursed Realm is affecting the realms connected to it. Nadakhan uses the Djinn Blade to smash the Teapot, absorbing all the spirits that were trapped there into the sword.

programme.title: Misfortune Rising
programme.desc: The Ninja are on a collision course to find the map to stop Nadakhan, they first must find him. Meanwhile, Jay makes a wish to change his future, but it could alter his past indefinitely. The ninja's search for Nadakhan's ship turns up nothing. Nadakhan's crew is struggling to handle an airship which used to sail only on the oceans. Nadakhan confronts Jay and talks him into making a wish that will win him Nya. Jay wishes that he wasn't born in a junkyard and was rich. The next moment, he receives a letter saying his father has died and he has inherited his estate. Jay rushes home to find his parents in the junkyard and finds out they are fine, but they reveal that he is adopted. Jay discovers that his real father is the actor who played his favorite movie hero. In an effort to trap the ninja, the Sky Pirates start raids all over NINJAGO City. Nadakhan kidnaps Kai, who makes two wishes, both of which go wrong. His third wish is to “make it all go away.” Nadakhan's first mate, Flintlocke, accidentally destroys the Realm Crystal and Cole steals Soto's map. The Destiny's Bounty mysteriously vanishes from the police impound yard.

programme.title: The Cloud
programme.desc: A storm is brewing over Knighton. Monstrox has taken the form of a cloud, and is raising an army of lightning infused Stone Monsters. His first target is the new Lavalands Amusement Park. Harmony reigns in Knighton as the Knights pursue their civilian lives: Lance has a TV talk show Axl is the singing chef on the show Jestro is the weatherman Clay is teaching at the Knights' Academy Macy, Ava and Merlok 2.0 travel the land in the Fortrex making sure the kingdom's defenses are ready (part of a plan she and Clay have) Aaron and his hover shield is travelling the land setting extreme records. Robin is at his workshop at the Knights' Academy doing an “independent study” – he's working on some top secret project for Merlok 2.0. It all seems excellent! We even see the Knights new vehicles – which have been optimized for civilian life (except for Clay's.) But storm clouds are brewing. Well, one storm cloud is brewing: the Cloud of Monstrox! Yes, the Book of Monsters has reconstituted himself and is now a cloud who needs a man on the ground to enact his new evil plan. He follows his old buddy Jestro as he goes across the realm on the weekends apologizing for being evil. ZAP! With one bolt of his evil magic lighting, the Cloud of Monstrox turns Jestro evil again (only this time a bit, well, too evil.) The evil duo are back together – and bring stone to life for the first time in the form of Gargoyles from the town of GHOULIA. Now they must gather the Forbidden Powers so that the Cloud of Monstrox can destroy the entire kingdom! A battle breaks out in the Lava Lands, where Lance and Alice Squires are reporting from the opening of the Cuthbert Richmond funded Lava Lands Amusement Park, rebuilt from the remains of Jestro's old HQ. Jestro and the Cloud are after something in the remains and as Merlok 2.0 sends out a call for the Knights to help Lance. Can Lance (with an assist from King Halbert in his Mech) hold-off Jestro, the Cloud and their new army of stone fighters?!

programme.title: A Little Rusty
programme.desc: The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro unlocks a mysterious Forbidden Power. What kind ofhavoc will they unleash? And can Merlok 2.0 and the NEXO KNIGHTS make the new COMBO NEXO Powers work? The Knights finally make it to the Lava Lands – using their various new forms of transport, which are all strictly civilian vechicles – and they must regroup and learn to fight together again to face the new threat of Jestro, the Cloud of Monstrox, and their STONE MONSTERS (in this case, Stone Gargoyles.) But Jestro and his monsters beat back the knights and recover the STAFF OF MONSTROX – which was buried under the ceremonial chamber from Episode 210 (and is now the Lava Puker amusement park ride) – and they get away on Jestro's EVIL MOBILE, which he recovers from the HQ garage. Macy says this is exactly why she's been touring the kingdom preparing everyone for the next attack. The Knights have to get it together because now the entire kingdom is under threat…again. Robin decides he must upgrade the Knights' vehicles and make them more “fight optimized.” Ava and Merlok 2.0 must figure out how to use new NEXO Powers because regular NEXO Powers do make Stone monsters back into stone, but the Cloud simply zaps them to life again. Meanwhile, in the IRON MOUNTAINS, Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox find the first of the Forbidden Powers: RELENTLESS RUST. They find the ROGUL STATUE holding the power and zap him to life. Now…they can rust those shiny knights to pieces! Ava and Merlok are attempting to use NEXO COMBO POWERS – with hilarious results – as they try to figure out how they might work. When Jestro attacks, he's able to halt the Fortrex by instantly rusting its tracks and wheels! Robin has his hands full trying to clean all the rust from the attack of Relentless Rust. As the Knights attempt to defend against Jestro, the Cloud is zapping statues to life. He hits a statue with a bolt of lightning as Clay is touching it. Something happens…Clay feels odd stiff as if rock is mixing with his body. Finally, Ava and Merlok 2.0 download to the Knights their new thing: a COMBO NEXO COMBO Power. It works! It can smash the animated statues to dust! They use it to defeat Jestro, but he and the Cloud get away with the Forbidden Power of Relentless Rust. Victory … sort of. Clay talks to Merlok 2.0…something has happened to him. What can they do? Merlok 2.0 is very concerned.

programme.title: Thunderstox
programme.desc: Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox encounters the sculptor. He helps unleash a horde of fierce garden gnomes on Knighton. What will the NEXO KNIGHTS do against this new enemy? Will their new COMBO NEXO Powers do the trick? As Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox head off on the Evil Mobile to 'store' the Forbidden Power in a secret location, they encounter…THE SCULPTOR. His real name is ROBERTO ARNOLDI. He's a sensitive and odd artist who has been laid off by the king (the King ordered a "smashing" statue of the Queen, and the Sculptor made a statue of the Queen literally smashing monsters. He takes everything very literally.) Jestro instructs him to make a "bad" statue that he can use to attack the knights. The Sculptor sets to work. Meanwhile, the NEXO KNIGHTS are discussing the COMBO NEXO Powers, the Forbidden Powers, and what all this means. Lance, meanwhile, decides that since his talk show career is on hold, he thinks he'll install cameras in the Fortrex and do a Big Brother-like expose show on the Knights (he decides NOT to tell the others.) Merlok 2.0 and the Cloud of Monstrox (each talking to their cohorts) explain the history of the Forbidden Powers: it's a history lesson about the WIZARDS' COUNCIL, the Forbidden Powers, and how they were stopped long ago. This visual montage leads Jestro to…MOUNT THUNDERSTROX. The Cloud of Monstrox shows him the circle of ten Standing Stones where he will insert the Forbidden Powers. "What'll happen after that?” asks Jestro, curious. "Oh, I don't want to spoil the surprise," says the Cloud. They insert the first Forbidden Power, Relentless Rust, and it locks into place on its stone. They go off to battle the Knights and collect the "bad" statue the sculptor is making. But he's made a literally bad statue…it's terrible ... garden gnomes. Like an amateur art student. And…it's not even finished. ("You can't rush bad genius!") The Knights attack with their newly modified vehicles and they succeed in destroying the Evil Mobile. They then try to use a COMBO NEXO Power, but can't…it had to be perfect to work (Ava and Merlok need to work on it.) As Jestro and the Cloud retreat, Merlok again talks to Clay about turning to stone! Merlok calls in Robin…he will need him to build something to help Clay as he becomes more and more impaired.

programme.title: Weekend At Halberts
programme.desc: Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party. In the meantime Jestro attacks the Fortrex, but he is confronted with the new NEXO Power "The Wedgie of Doom". Clay is turned to stone and everyone is gloomy. Especially King Halbert. In order to get everything in a better mood Aaron organizes a celebration. The King wants a reenactment of Clay's heroic rescue of the Queen. He is (as usual) totally unaware of Clay's situation. In order not to disappoint him further, the Knights get a remote control for Clay's Battle suit and is thus able to “perform” as Clay. Lance is happy to exercise his acting abilities and quickly gets into the role of the uptight knight of knights. Ava is working on reinstalling Merlok 2.0 into the Fortrex with Robin. She is also preparing the Fortrex for a visit from the new Knights' Academy novices. It is a fieldtrip with Principal Brickland and Sir Griffiths with the goal of teaching the kids about these new so-called High-tech battle strategies. Not really feeling it for anything modern, it quickly turns into a regular trip back memory lane for Brickland and Sir Griffiths. This out of control excursion is an excellent moment for Jestro who is looking for an opportunity to cheer up the defeated Monstrox. Unfortunately, for Jestro, Ava is able to make Merlok 2.0 functional again, and the Novices are able to fight Jestro and his monsters off using the NEXO Power: Wedgie of Doom. It is a humiliating defeat. Apparently, this is just what the doctor ordered for Monstrox. A good laugh at someone else's expense. His evil mood is back on.

programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: A Taste of Poison
programme.desc: Reverend Dwight Moore is at death's door when he is transferred from his local hospital to Memorial Hospital in Chapel Hill. With all the expertise and technology of modern medicine at their disposal, doctors are still unable to find of the cause of Moore's symptoms, which include stomach pain, numbness, and hallucinations. His devoted wife Blanche remains by his side throughout his puzzling illness. She tries to comfort him by bringing his favorite banana pudding from home. When Moore's vital functions begin to shut down, a visiting specialist examines him and notices white striation lines on his fingernails, an indication of arsenic poisoning. Tests reveal that Moore has ingested more arsenic than any living person on record. Police investigators question him about his wife and discover that Blanche Moore's two previous husbands both met untimely deaths. Their bodies are exhumed and found to contain high levels of arsenic, and Blanche Moore is convicted of murder and sentenced to death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bodies of Evidence
programme.desc: It is difficult to convict a murderer if the body can't be found. But forensic science is finding ways to do it. Devious killers can think up many was to dispose of their victim's remains, but they are often no matches for creative and devoted investigators. A speck of blood, a piece of a fingernail or a strand of hair may now be enough evidence to prove a murder and capture a killer.

programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: LOST RECIPES
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: INDIPEDIA
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: MID WICKET TALES
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. programme.title: DESTRUCTION DECODED
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.desc: The sixth generation Opel/Vauxhall Astra and third generation Peugeot 308 are both based on the Stellantis EMP2 platform and, unsurprisingly, score very similarly across all four areas of assessment. Both the offset test and the full-width crash test highlighted marginal chest injury protection for average male and small female drivers, and neither car was equipped with a centre airbag for far-side crash protection, a countermeasure which is increasingly common on modern cars. I suoi ex compagni di lotta fanno di tutto per coinvolgerlo nuovamente in azioni rivoluzionarie, ma lui è riluttante e sfiduciato. Finché si butta a capofitto in una rovinosa spedizione al Sud...
